ctx.x: That McKinney's Cottonpickers, that's -- when Don Redmon was fronting that band, a heck of a band, McKinney's. Now, how in the world did McKinney come to manipulate and get great musicians in his band, Cubie Austin on drums. He did everything, great drummer. And he never fronted the band. Maybe he did when the band first started, but McKinney -- how did he maneuver, manipulate and get great guys like Don Redmon? He must have been paying pretty good money to arrange, write for the band and conduct it.

And we ran into Don, McKinney's Cottonpicker's band in Cleveland when we were there, naturally starving, stranded. But I can't figure this out, how he manipulated to get those great guys like Don Redmon. Don held forth at the Connie's Inn quite a time, you know, and good band. Old Big Sid.
